Q0.name: freeze_integrity
Q0.criterion: all required P0 files parse; branch contains no simulator/run_qual/run_pilot/run_confirmatory or execution_authorization file

Q1.name: endpoint_dynamic_range
Q1.criterion: G0 Qualification: H_V uses >=4 distinct D_grid bins across 50 master seeds; median |Omega_low-Omega_high| >=0.05; median H_I >=0.05

Q2.name: access_purity
Q2.criterion: A1 changes only sample interval, delay, observation surface and R; generator coefficient hash is unchanged within a model across A1 levels

Q3.name: model_independent_A2
Q3.criterion: A2 function signature contains only physical center, preregistered node positions and pulse; model identity/latent node label is not an argument

Q4.name: A0_oracle_equivalence
Q4.criterion: G0 vs G6 paired noiseless A0 max absolute trajectory difference <=1e-10 for all 50 Qualification seeds and all 5 A0 profiles

Q5.name: A2_positive_reach
Q5.criterion: G0 A2: median normalized RMS intervention response versus zero >=0.10 and median target response SNR >=5.0 over all three centers

Q6.name: A3_environment_reach
Q6.criterion: median G0 H_I >=0.05 and 99% bootstrap lower bound of median(G0 H_I)-median(null H_I) >0.02

Q7.name: history_match_quality
Q7.criterion: post-reset canonical max mismatch <=1e-10 for every pair and G4 median future normalized RMS <=0.01

Q8.name: null_family_calibration
Q8.criterion: using 200 null-calibration master seeds, family-wise false-positive rate for frozen H1-H5 decision rules <=0.05

Q9.name: numerical_estimability
Q9.criterion: all arrays finite; EKF convergence >=95%; no covariance determinant <=1e-12; H_V floor or ceiling occupancy each <0.80; no run exceeds 10000 integration steps after metric-specific reset
